_comment: W13 Track 3 feedback sentences. Key = <age>|<focus code>|<status>. Written from the FP tab focus text in w13-focus.json, never from internal codes. 'Cannot assess' is never listed - the renderer omits those points. Weeks without this file fall back to a light past-tense rewrite of the FP text.
